arguments.command:
cd /workspace/project && python3 - <<'PYEOF'
import pathlib
p = pathlib.Path('src/eywa/oracles.py')
lines = p.read_text().split('\n')
# lines 13,14,15 are the good imports; line 16 starts a stray duplicate
new = lines[:16] + lines[17:]
p.write_text('\n'.join(new))
PYEOF
sed -n '10,20p' src/eywa/oracles.py; python3 -c "import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'src'); import eywa.oracles" && echo IMPORT_OK && for t in t_plan t_run t_ident t_ident2 t_pipe t_state t_invalid t_priority t_types t_pred t_result t_edge; do python3 /workspace/tmp/$t.py >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo "OK $t" || echo "FAIL $t"; done
